description: Create Supabase PostgreSQL schema (converting D1 migrations to Supabase-compatible PostgreSQL with pgvector and RLS policies). Create a shared Supabase client library for both client-side (anon key) and server-side (service role key) usage in Pages Functions.
steps: Create supabase/migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql: Convert the existing migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql from D1/SQLite syntax to PostgreSQL. Key changes: TEXT PRIMARY KEY -> uuid with gen_random_uuid() default, INTEGER -> boolean where appropriate, datetime('now') -> now(), JSON columns -> jsonb, add the pgvector extension and a vector(768) column to source_chunks for embeddings.

Create supabase/migrations/0002_rls_policies.sql: Add Row-Level Security policies per the security.md steering file. Learners can only read their own attempts/results/conversations, read published modules and approved questions. Instructors read/write modules they own. Service role bypasses RLS.
Create supabase/migrations/0003_seed_demo_data.sql: Convert migrations/0002_seed_demo_data.sql to PostgreSQL syntax for the demo module data.
Create src/lib/supabase/client.ts: Browser-side Supabase client using NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY environment variables. Export createBrowserClient() function.

Create src/lib/supabase/server.ts: Server-side Supabase client for use in Pages Functions using SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. Export createServiceClient(env) function that takes the Cloudflare env bindings.

Create src/lib/supabase/types.ts: Database type definitions generated from the schema (manually typed to match the PostgreSQL tables). Export Database type for use with supabase-js generic type parameter.
Update functions/tsconfig.json to include the src/lib/supabase path for shared types.

Create a .env.example file documenting all required environment variables: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
acceptance_criteria: supabase/migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql is valid PostgreSQL with uuid PKs, pgvector extension, and vector(768) column on source_chunks
supabase/migrations/0002_rls_policies.sql enables RLS on all user-facing tables with correct policies
src/lib/supabase/client.ts exports a createBrowserClient() that returns a typed SupabaseClient
src/lib/supabase/server.ts exports createServiceClient(env) for Pages Functions
src/lib/supabase/types.ts exports Database interface matching the schema
